text:
maria: quick question — hit a failure during a key rotation for the sampleapp deployed in k8s. who owns the rotation workflow (platform, devx, or app team)? and what should the SDK do at runtime for live key refresh?

jon: oof. is this the env-var swap pattern (REDWOOD_API_KEY) or are you using a k8s secret that we mount?

maria: we use a secret named sampleapp-redwood-key and set REDWOOD_API_KEY on the deployment. we rolled a new secret, applied it, and the pod restarted but some requests still got 401s for ~2m. logs show the SDK cached creds in memory.

samir: that matches an issue I saw — our SDK currently reads env var once on init and caches it. no file/secret watch or provider callback. previously ok because keys were long-lived. for rotations we need a refresh path.

rachel: agreed. suggested pattern: SDK should support a credential provider interface + default env var provider that can be polled or subscribe to FS events when secrets are mounted. also CLI and python/js SDK parity: both should accept REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_KEY as fallbacks so onboarding docs don't break.

devx-bot: deploy failed: sampleapp/2345 — 401 error spike after secret update. Related PR: https://git.internal/repo/p/1234

jon: can we make the runtime behavior clear: 1) on 401 retry once after fetching fresh creds from provider, 2) if still 401 bubble up; 3) emit metric `auth.rotation.attempt` ?

samir: +1. but be careful: automatic retry should not create an infinite loop when key revocation is intentional. one immediate retry after refresh is safe. and SDK should expose a hook so apps can opt out.

maria: also a UX thing — our k8s rollout triggered a brief dual-key window where old key still accepted for a minute, then revoked. some clients hit revoked state mid-request. maybe we should document best-of-both-worlds: issue new key, update secret, stagger rollout, then revoke old key after N minutes.

rachel: for project/org scoping, recommend env vars: REDWOOD_ORG_ID and REDWOOD_PROJECT_ID. SDK should prefer explicit header config but fall back to env. fallback chain: CLI args > env vars > mounted file provider > metadata server.

samir: for rotation automation: platform-team could expose an API to create ephemeral keys (short TTL) and a sidecar that swaps keys and signals app via SIGHUP or file touch. SDK can watch file and refresh automatically.

platform-team: (cc) we've got a secrets-sidecar prototype, happy to demo. main gap is SDK parity for file-watch vs env-init.

maria: action items: @platform-team demo sidecar, @samir/eng make SDK support a credential provider interface + default file-watcher provider, @rachel update docs to list env var names and rotation playbook, and add one-line retry-on-401 behavior guidance.

jon: small PR suggestion: patch the node SDK to read env var on every request if process.env.XXX changed (cheap check) until we land file-watch provider.

samir: will draft an RFC for provider interface. thanks — this explains the 2m 401 window.

maria: thanks all. ping me when the demo is scheduled so we can dogfood the flow with the sampleapp and avoid surprises during the next rotation. :thumbsup:
